description:
SUSPECTED DEFECT, UNCONFIRMED. Filed as a TODO at the maintainer's request 2026-08-05. Do not act on it as if confirmed, and do not 'fix' the sign on the strength of this bead alone.

THE OBSERVATION: PoissonRatioModel::MatproZircaloy computes nu = E/(2G) - 1 from MATPRO's independently-fitted Young's and shear modulus lines. The resulting nu INCREASES with temperature -- measured 0.386353680 at 600 K, 0.5674999999999999 at 1500 K, crossing the incompressible limit 0.5 at 1354.84 K (this crossing is what op-6sl.7 gates on, now refused rather than clamped in LinearElastic::from_models).

WHY THAT LOOKS WRONG: the abstract of Northwood (1975) on Zircaloy elastic constants states that measured Poisson's ratio DECREASES with temperature. If that is right, the port reproduces a correlation whose temperature derivative has the opposite sign to the measurement it is meant to represent -- and the 0.5 crossover would be an artefact of the sign error rather than a real (if unguarded) upstream defect.

WHY IT IS UNCONFIRMED: only the ABSTRACT was read. The paper itself is unread because outbound egress in this container blocks every literature host (see the egress bead). An abstract is not sufficient evidence to overturn a transcription -- it does not say over what temperature range, for what alloy/texture/cold-work state, or whether the quoted trend is of measured nu or of a derived quantity.

WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT, in order:
1. Read Northwood 1975 in full and record the actual nu(T) table with its range and material condition.
2. Re-derive nu = E/(2G) - 1 from the MATPRO E and G fits as transcribed here and check the port reproduces MATPRO's own arithmetic -- i.e. separate 'did we transcribe correctly?' from 'is MATPRO right?'. These are different questions and only the first is this port's responsibility.
3. Only if the transcription is faithful AND the literature contradicts MATPRO: document it as an upstream defect with the measurement cited, exactly as the rkdcha.F90 and nmvpir.F90 discrepancies are handled. Reproduce, pin with a test, never silently correct.

DEPENDS ON THE EGRESS BLOCKER. This cannot be resolved in this container.

Related: op-6sl.7 (crossover gating, now decided -- refuse), docs/validation/poisson_ratio_zircaloy.md (the validation case, whose benchmark data is blocked on the same egress problem).

---
RE-FILED 2026-08-12 with its original id. This bead was created in an earlier session but never published, because beads-rs `bd` could not push the store ref (kopitiam#19). It survived only in the local v1 store, which diverged from origin's migrated v2 store. Preserved at ref refs/beads/local-preserve-20260812. Original status at preservation: open.
title: materials: MATPRO Zircaloy dnu/dT may have the WRONG SIGN -- literature unread, egress blocked
